copy.heroHeadline: A small Magnolia building, big on living.
copy.aboutLede: Cavernous by Seattle standards — a two-bedroom, two-bath layout that gives every roommate, partner, or family member their own space, without compromise.
copy.aboutQuote: “Upper-floor homes capture breathtaking views of the Magnolia neighborhood and the Seattle skyline beyond.”
copy.aboutMetaLine: Nine homes · 1 BR – 2 BR · Magnolia, Seattle
copy.aboutBody:
Magnolia Crestview is a small, well-kept building with a handful of homes — bright one-bedrooms and generously sized two-bedrooms. The two-bedroom plans are spacious by Seattle standards: full updated kitchens, two bathrooms, abundant closet space, and private decks with built-in storage.

Every layout was drawn to maximize daily livability. Real bedrooms with real closets. Pass-through kitchens, not galleys. Outdoor space that's actually yours. It's a building that works whether you're solo, partnered, or sharing the rent.

Homes don't come available often, and when they do, they go fast. Nine are open now.
copy.plan1brDesc: An open kitchen and living area connect to a separate bedroom with closet and a full bath. Every one-bedroom in the building includes a private deck and a quick walk to Discovery Park.
copy.plan2brDesc: Two true bedrooms, two full bathrooms, an updated kitchen, and a private deck with built-in storage. The layout gives every roommate, partner, or family member their own space — steps from Discovery Park.
copy.featureSkylineDesc: Select upper-floor units look out over Magnolia and the downtown Seattle skyline. Cascade views available.
copy.neighborhoodHeading: Magnolia, at the edge of everything.
copy.neighborhoodLede: A peninsula neighborhood with trail access to Discovery Park, the weekend energy of Magnolia Village, and direct bus routes to downtown. Filter by category — or just explore the map.
